text.es: ¿Sabes lo que hacía? Consolarme. Decirme que olvidase a Fina porque no iba a volver. Me convenció de que Fina me abandonó y de que no me quería. ¿Sabes lo que puede llegar a doler eso?
text.en: You know what he used to do? Comfort me. Tell me to forget Fina because she was never coming back. He convinced me that Fina had abandoned me and that she didn't love me. Do you know how much that can hurt?
